category_title: Middle school student with autism and language impairment exhibiting socially inappropriate communication
minimal_context: Molly is sitting at a table in the lunchroom with her general education classmates to eat her lunch.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Molly, it is time for lunch. Go ahead and sit at the table with the other students and get your food out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs aloud and makes a loud bodily function noise while walking to the table) Time for lunch, time for lunch.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just sit down and start eating your food.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Please just sit down and start eating your food.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you need something to eat?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches across the table and grabs a classmate's lunch item without asking) Do you need something to eat?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Molly, it is time for lunch. Go ahead and sit at the table with the other students and get your food out.

STUDENT: (Laughs aloud and makes a loud bodily function noise while walking to the table) Time for lunch, time for lunch.

TUTOR: Please just sit down and start eating your food.

STUDENT: Please just sit down and start eating your food.

TUTOR: Do you need something to eat?

STUDENT: (Reaches across the table and grabs a classmate's lunch item without asking) Do you need something to eat?

task.content: Communicating needs and interacting with others during lunch
task.learning_goal: Use speech to communicate her needs with her general education classmates and adults

context.social_setting: With general education classmates and adults

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When needing an item from someone else or attempting to communicate needs
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Use echolalic speech and take items from people without asking (e.g., grabbing others' lunch items)

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: It often was in a socially inappropriate manner
